title: nexahealth-partnership-scratchpad-priya
content:
Quick brain dump for NexaHealth (prospective partner / enterprise pilot)

Account snapshot (what I know)
- Name: NexaHealth (mid-market healthcare analytics vendor)
- HQ: Boston, MA
- Estimated size: ~450 employees; core data science org ~25-40
- Tech stack: AWS (EKS, S3), PostgreSQL, Python (FastAPI), some infra on GCP for analytics pipelines
- ML footprint: internal models for risk scoring and triage, experimenting with LLMs for patient-facing chat and clinician summarization. Likely using a mix of open-source LLMs (local infra) + some commercial APIs for prototypes.
- Compliance: HIPAA-sensitive. They already use a KMS and have SOC2 controls in progress.
- Signals / triggers: strong push to reduce clinician time spent on notes, also building patient triage chatbot (NPS/ops ops dollars). Recently posted hiring for MLOps engineer + a role mentioning "LLM integrations" (Jan 2026).

Why Redwood could fit (value props to highlight)
- Production-grade inference (latency + reliability): their chat/triage use case needs predictable latency at low cost. Redwood Dedicated/Private for HIPAA can be a big win.
- Private deployment / VPC & KMS support: addresses HIPAA + data residency concerns directly.
- Cost controls & Optimize tooling: help them reduce token/unit costs vs hosted API experiments.
- Observability + rollouts: can A/B rollout models safely (reduce clinician risk), quality monitoring tied to prompt sets.

Key contacts (to find emails / intros)
- Head of ML / Director of Data Science (likely decision maker for tooling) — target for technical intro.
- VP of Engineering / Platform — procurement for deployment model (VPC, infra ownership).
- Head of Compliance / Security — need to address HIPAA + SOC2 controls early.
- Product owner for Clinical UX — will care about UX/latency and fallback behaviors.

Outbound email drafts (short, try to be conversational)
1) Cold outreach (short)
Subject: Redwood + NexaHealth — reliable, private LLM inference for clinical triage
Hi [Name],
Saw NexaHealth's hiring for MLOps + work on "LLM integrations" — congrats. At Redwood we help teams ship LLM features with predictable latency and private deployments (VPC + KMS) so you can keep PHI on-prem or in your cloud.
Would love 20m to share a few producer-to-product stories (how we reduced latency/cost and enabled safe rollouts for a healthcare customer). Are you available next week?
Best,
Priya

2) Technical intro (post-resp)
Subject: Quick follow-up + architecture notes for private inference
Thanks for taking a look, [Name]. A couple of quick things we often discuss with teams like yours:
- Private control plane + customer-managed network (no PHI leaves your VPC)
- KMS/HSM integration for key management and audit trails
- Predictable throughput via Dedicated pools and autoscaling policies (example: 99th % latency SLOs)
Happy to share a short diagram and case study — can I send over a 1-pager or set up 20m?

3) Short follow-up cadence (if no reply)
- Day 3: brief follow-up + one-sentence customer outcome
- Day 10: share relevant case study + ask about best person on your team to talk to

Objection handling (cheat sheet)
- "We can just use X cloud provider endpoints"
  - Acknowledge: yes, cloud endpoints are easy to start.
  - Differentiate: Redwood is built for inference economics and production SLOs — unified interface across hosted/dedicated/private so you can prototype on hosted then migrate to private without rework. Also our Optimize tooling gives measurable cost reductions (batching, KV cache, quantization suggestions).
- "Security/HIPAA concerns"
  - Response: We support Private deployments (VPC + on-prem package) with KMS/HSM, SOC2 controls and audit logs. We can scope a security review and supply architecture diagrams and documentation early in the process.
- "Cost looks high"
  - Response: Typical pattern: initial POC on hosted API to validate product UX, then move to Dedicated/Private to cut unit cost. We provide Optimize recommendations and can model cost savings vs current approach.
- "Complexity of integration"
  - Response: SDK + REST are intentionally simple; we provide examples (FastAPI + Python) and a migration plan. Our Console has tracing hooks so you can instrument calls quickly.

Questions to answer / things to research before outreach
- Confirm exact PHI flow: is any PHI sent to third-party APIs today? Which parts of the pipeline touch it?
- Which team owns ML infra? Who is the person that would sign off on dedicated infra?
- What SLAs do they expect for triage/chat (p90/p99 latency targets)?
- Are there regulatory constraints around model provenance or logging (e.g., retention limits)?
- Any existing contracts with API providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, other vendors) — cost baseline for comparison.

Meeting prep checklist (if we get intro)
- 5-minute intros + roles
- 10-minute pain & current architecture (they draw it)
- 10-minute demo / architecture sketch: private vs hosted + sample cost math
- 5-minute next steps: pilot scope, timeline, security review

Proposed pilot (1 pager in bullets)
- Objective: Reduce clinician note time for triage + provide safe patient chatbot for scheduling
- Duration: 6–8 weeks
- Scope: 1 clinical workflow, integrate with existing API (FastAPI) + host model in Redwood Private (VPC) with KMS, set up basic monitoring + quality checks on sample prompts
- Success metrics: 30% reduction in clinician time on chosen workflow OR X% automation rate + no critical safety incidents; infra cost within target budget

Next actions / TODOs
- Find email for Head of ML (LinkedIn + job posting -> likely L. Martinez) — Jordan to intro? (task)
- Pull comparable healthcare customer case study (ask solutions eng) — Olivia to check library
- Draft short architecture slide + 1-pager for compliance (Priya) — due 2026-02-05
- Add NexaHealth to outbound sequence in Outreach/HubSpot once contact validated

Notes to self (informal)
- Keep outreach light — regulatory/PD teams are busy. Open with private deployment + compliance assurances.
- Emphasize migration story: prototype on hosted then lift-and-shift to Private/Dedicated.
- Use Optimize metrics (quantitative) in meetings — finance/infra love concrete cost math.

Rough outreach links/logs
- Job posting: https://jobs.nexahealth.com/roles/mlops-engineer (saw Jan 2026)
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/nexahealth (to find Head of ML)

End of scratchpad.
